title: Modular DX Playlists: Guided SDK + Docs Quickstart Paths
creator: Amira Clarke
description: Build and track an initiative to produce modular, composable "playlists" that guide new and returning developers through SDK integration, core docs, and quickstarts. Each playlist is a short linear path (3–6 steps) that mixes code samples, runnable quickstarts, and one-pager conceptual docs. The goal is to reduce time-to-first-success for common Redwood flows (hosted API call, embedding pipeline, dedicated deployment smoke test). This ticket covers planning the initial set of 6 playlists, defining OKRs and success metrics, coordinating with design/engineering for assets, and instrumenting telemetry to measure completion and drop-off. This initiative should surface into the DX roadmap tracker and map to activation OKRs for Q2.
acceptance_criteria: 6 initial playlists authored and reviewed (SDK: Node, Python, Go; Docs: quickstart, troubleshooting)
Each playlist has a runnable code sample and CI-verified quickstart that completes in <10 minutes
Console entry points & badges added to the developer hub landing page
Telemetry hooks instrumented to capture step completion and time-to-complete
Clear mapping from playlist completion to activation metric in analytics dashboard
deliverables: Playlists content matrix (topics, steps, estimated time)
Authoring templates for SDK and docs writers
6 quickstart repos or runnable gists with tests
Design comps for playlist UI in Developer Hub
success_metrics: Reduce median time-to-first-success from 18m to <=10m for targeted flows
Increase 7-day retention of new signups who complete a playlist by 12%
Playlist completion rate >= 25% for users who view the playlist landing page
Each quickstart has <3 user-reported friction issues in first 30 days
risks: Authoring burden spreads across multiple SDK teams; may delay content delivery
Instrumentation gaps if SDKs lack standard telemetry hooks
Design bandwidth constraints for Developer Hub integration
Overlap with existing onramp/quickstart initiatives causing duplication
decisions: Scope trimmed to 6 playlists for initial launch to limit cross-team work
Telemetry will use existing console event schema (event: dx.playlist.step_completed)
Playlists will be language-agnostic by design but include 3 language-specific runnable samples
